items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: I went down there and I talked with Pearl and I said, 'Pearl, would you come on and work down here at the Village Vanguard for me'

ctx.x: Yeah. So I told Eddie I was going and I was going to try and find somebody to fill in for me. Well, everybody was working and I couldn't find somebody. Then somebody said, Pearl Bailey ain't doing nothing. I said, where does Pearl live?
